about_short_description.short_description: Nira Energy builds products to provide transmission insights throughout the interconnection process.

product.name: Prospecting Tool
product.description: A software tool for screening and identifying transmission sites with reduced interconnection risks using ISO-accurate data and real-time modeling.

product.name: In-Queue Tool
product.description: A software solution that provides early access to interconnection queue data and modeling results to identify upgrade risks and streamline project management.

product.name: Teams Insights
product.description: A collaborative platform for interconnection teams to share data, insights, and streamline decision-making during the transmission interconnection process.
